item.title: MIRZADEH Return with New Version of 80s Classic ‘You’re My Heart, You’re My Soul’
item.description: Finnish black/dark metal royalty Mirzadeh has released a black metal version and music video of the 80s classic You’re My Heart, You’re My Soul. After experiencing several lineup changes, the 25-year-old Mirzadeh is also working on new material with new keyboardist Descrato (Star Insight, Arina) and session guitarist Asagor (Boneset). item.title: MISERERE LUMINIS Announce New Album “Sidera”, Out March 6th
item.description: Helmed by three figures revered in the Québec Black Metal underground, MISERERE LUMINIS have shaped an anguished, atmospheric and singular body of work since their 2008 formation. Following a self-titled debut “Miserere Luminis” (2009) and acclaimed follow-up “Ordalie” (2023), the trio now heralds their arrival on DMP with exceptional new album, “Sidera“, to be released March 6th, 2026. item.description: The self-reliant, boundary-pushing post-punk trio Sonic Punter has released a new single, Cloud Indigo. item.title: Stu Marshall’s EMPIRES OF EDEN Announce First-Ever Digital Release of Remixed & Remastered Early Albums, Out now
item.description: Visionary guitarist and composer Stu Marshall reignites the legacy of EMPIRES OF EDEN with the first-ever digital release of the project’s iconic early catalogue. For the first time, the band’s first four albums are available worldwide in fully remixed and remastered editions, released digitally via Massacre Records.
